Thermostats of Trane Technologies (Trane XL series, American Standard Gold /
Platinum, UX360...) in Gladys, through the cloud of their app: **Nexia**
(mynexia.com), **Trane Home** (tranehome.com) or **American Standard Home**
(asairhome.com, also called Asair).

> **Unofficial integration**, not affiliated with Trane Technologies. It uses
> the unofficial API of the mobile app (the one the
> [nexia](https://github.com/bdraco/nexia) library and Home Assistant use),
> which may change without notice. It has never been tested with a real account:
> only against the answers recorded by the nexia library. Please report what
> you see.

## Configuration

1. **Brand (app)**: the app you sign in to. The three are the same cloud
   under three addresses.
2. **E-mail address** and **password** of that account. The password is kept
   by Gladys in its database (not encrypted, never shown again) and sent only
   to the cloud of the brand chosen.
3. Save. The status says how many thermostats and zones were found; the
   devices are in the **Discovery** tab.

**Test the connection** signs in again and lists the thermostats and zones.

### A refused password

Several wrong passwords in a row may lock the account. When the cloud refuses
the e-mail or the password, Gladys stops; it tries again by itself only twice,
6 hours and then 24 hours later (kept across restarts), then waits for you:
fix the password and save, or press **Test the connection**.

## Devices

**One device per thermostat** (the system):

- indoor humidity (%);
- outdoor temperature, when the system has a sensor (kept out of the room
  temperature in Gladys);
- system status (text from the cloud: "Cooling", "System Idle"...);
- fan mode (auto, on, circulate: the options the thermostat offers);
- humidify / dehumidify setpoints (%), when a humidifier or a dehumidifier is
  installed (read only).

**One device per zone** (a system without zoning has one zone, with the name
of the thermostat):

- temperature;
- heating setpoint and cooling setpoint;
- mode: off, heating, cooling, auto (emergency heat is shown as heating);
- operating state: idle, heating, cooling;
- schedule or hold (text from the cloud).

Temperatures are in the unit of the account (°F or °C) when the device is
created; Gladys converts them if the account changes unit later.

The values are read **every two minutes** (the cloud answers "nothing new"
most of the time, which costs almost nothing). A thermostat the cloud reports
offline is shown unreachable, and its values are not published.

## Commands (off by default)

By default Gladys only reads. Tick **Allow commands** to let the dashboard,
the scenes, HomeKit (the only voice assistant of Gladys that reaches a
thermostat) and the Thermostat service of Gladys change:

- the **heating and cooling setpoints** of a zone. A value is checked before
  anything else (40 to 99 °F, or 4.5 to 37 °C, in the unit of the Gladys
  feature): a value out of it is refused, never adjusted. It is then rounded
  like the app (1 °F, 0.5 °C) and checked against the limits of the
  thermostat; the other setpoint moves to keep the gap the thermostat asks
  for (the "deadband"), as in the app. A thermostat that gives no deadband
  refuses the setpoint commands;
- the **mode** of a zone (off, heating, cooling, auto). **Off stops heating
  and cooling, with no frost protection**, and it may come from HomeKit
  ("turn off the thermostat") or from the Thermostat service of Gladys, not
  only from you;
- the **fan mode**.

Before each command Gladys reads the thermostat again: if it is offline, if
the zone is gone or if the value is already there, nothing is sent. One
command at a time: a slow cloud may take up to 20 seconds; Gladys shows the
command as sent after 4 seconds, and a command arriving meanwhile is refused
at once (try again a few seconds later). A dropped connection during a
command is reported as "may not have reached the cloud", and the thermostat
is read again. There is never a
switch to turn the heating off: "turn everything off" in Gladys does not
touch the thermostats.

A setpoint changed this way may hold until the next step of the schedule of
the thermostat, as in the app.

## Limits

- HTTP 429 (too many requests): every request waits (2 minutes to 6 hours),
  across restarts too.
- Cloud unreachable: retried after 2 minutes, then less and less often (up to
  30 minutes).
- The first house of the account only.
- Not yet: presets (home, away, sleep), schedule resume, emergency heat,
  humidity setpoint commands, air cleaner, RoomIQ sensors.

## Privacy

The e-mail address and the password go only to the cloud of the brand chosen.
The session key stays in memory. `/data` of the container holds only a random
identifier of this installation (the app sends one), the end of a 429 pause
and the state of a refusal (a hash of the brand and the e-mail, never the
password). If `/data` cannot be written, that identifier is new at each
restart, and the account may list one more "phone" each time (they can be
removed in the app).

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Nexia / Trane / Am. Standard asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| How it works | `section` | No | Gladys reads the thermostats of your account every two minutes from the cloud of the app (Nexia, Trane Home or American Standard Home). Each thermostat becomes a Gladys device (Discovery tab) with its humidity, outdoor temperature, status and fan mode; each zone becomes a device with its temperature, heating and cooling setpoints, mode and operating state. Unofficial integration, not affiliated with Trane Technologies: it uses the unofficial API of the app, and has never been tested with a real account (see the documentation). |
| Brand (app) | `select` | Yes | The app you sign in to: the same cloud under three names. |
| E-mail address of the account | `string` | Yes |  |
| Password of the account | `secret` | Yes | Kept by Gladys in its database, never shown again, sent only to the cloud of the brand chosen. Several wrong passwords in a row may lock the account: after a refusal Gladys tries again only twice (6 h, then 24 h later). |
| Commands | `section` | No | By default Gladys only reads. Once the option below is ticked, the dashboard, the scenes, HomeKit (the only voice assistant that reaches thermostats) and the Thermostat service of Gladys can change the heating and cooling setpoints, the mode of a zone (off, heating, cooling, auto) and the fan mode. The Off mode stops heating AND cooling, with no frost protection, and may come from HomeKit ("turn off") or from the Thermostat service. Setpoints are checked against the limits of the thermostat; there is never a switch to cut the heating. |
| Allow commands | `boolean` | No |  |
| Language of the devices | `select` | No | Names of the devices, features and options. |

## How to install Nexia / Trane / Am. Standard in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Nexia / Trane / Am. Standard appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/lm1lc3n7/gladys-nexia:0.1.2`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-nexia](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-nexia).

Nexia / Trane / Am. Standard requires Gladys `>=5.1.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Nexia / Trane / Am. Standard is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [LM1LC3N7](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7), not by the Gladys core team.
